interpretation.grouping: Original protocol grouping retained; no operational acceptance gate was run.
interpretation.matchingMissDetected: Maximum score over the fixed gallery below the unchanged LFW threshold, conditional on detection.
interpretation.candidateAcceptanceFailClosed: Matching misses / all submitted probes, assuming every detection failure rejects; offline candidates, not issued credentials.
interpretation.historicalCombined: Historical detection failures plus matching misses; not an issuance-risk estimate.
interpretation.weighting: Pooled attempt-weighted descriptive rates; subjects have unequal probe counts.
interpretation.uncertainty: 95% percentile subject-cluster bootstrap intervals conditional on the observed gallery and thresholds; whole subject probe sets resampled. Not a worst-case adversarial bound. Intervals omitted at empirical 0/1 boundaries.

bootstrap.weighting: ratio of pooled counts per draw
bootstrap.gallery: held fixed; gallery-selection uncertainty not estimated
bootstrap.anyMissInterpretation: descriptive fraction of subjects with a miss in their available finite probe sets; unequal probe counts; not an adaptive attack probability
